raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return Program (C-Section Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Gradual return to activity, core reconnect, walking tolerance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-4 (Weeks 4-8 Postpartum)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Gentle Walk + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (supine) 3x6 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor gentle contractions (supine) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          seated shoulder rolls 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          seated cat-cow (spinal mobility) 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          standing calf raises (support) 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Breath + Lower Body Basics":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (sidelying) 3x6 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor gentle contractions (sidelying) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          sit-to-stand from chair (arms assisted) 2x6 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          wall slides (shoulder mobility) 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          heel slides (supine, short range) 2x6 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walk + Posture Care":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (seated) 3x6 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor gentle contractions (seated) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          standing hip abduction (light, support) 2x6 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          scapular retraction (bandless squeeze) 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          gentle thoracic rotations (seated) 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 28m "Walk + Controlled Mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (crook lying) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor gentle contractions (supine) 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          sit-to-stand from chair (arms free) 3x6 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raises (support) 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Breath + Range":
        warmup:
          walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (sidelying) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor gentle contractions (sidelying) 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          heel slides (supine, controlled) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          wall slides (shoulder mobility) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 28m "Walk + Balance Intro":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (seated) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor gentle contractions (seated) 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          standing hip abduction (support) 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          tandem stand (near support) 3x20 seconds rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Walk + Gentle Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing with reach (supine) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions with breath 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          sit-to-stand from chair (controlled) 3x8 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raises (support) 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 28m "Mobility + Core Reconnect (No Abs)":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 3x6 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          heel slides (supine, slow) 3x10 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          wall slides (shoulder mobility) 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          seated march (tiny range) 2x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Walk + Balance Progression":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (seated) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions (seated) 3x12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          standing hip abduction (support) 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          tandem stand eyes forward 3x30 seconds rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Walk + Functional Basics":
        warmup:
          walk 18m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing with reach (supine) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions with holds 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          sit-to-stand from chair (slow tempo) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raises (unsupported if safe) 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 28m "Mobility + Posture":
        warmup:
          walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          heel slides (supine) 3x10 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
          wall slides (shoulder mobility) 3x12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 32m "Walk + Balance Steady":
        warmup:
          walk 18m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing (seated) 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor contractions (seated) 3x12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          standing hip abduction (support) 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk (hallway, support nearby) 4x20 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2: Weeks 5-8 (Post 6-Week Check to Moderate)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + Gentle Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing with 2s exhale holds 3x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit-to-stand (slow tempo) 3x10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 2x8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing hip hinge patterning (hands on thighs) 3x6 rpe 3 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Mobility + Marching":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching (upright) 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          wall slides (shoulder) 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          heel-toe raises (alternating) 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Walk + Balance Challenge":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic floor contractions with holds 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          standing hip abduction (longer pause) 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk slow 4x24 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          wall push-up (high incline) 3x6 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Walk + Strength Foundations":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          sit-to-stand (controlled) 3x10 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge patterning (hands to chair) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Mobility + Upper Body":
        warmup:
          walk 12m
        main straight_sets:
          wall slides 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall push-up (high incline) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Walk + Balance and Steps":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          pelvic floor holds 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          step-up to low step (4-6in, controlled) 3x6 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          tandem walk 4x30 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 38m "Walk + Functional Progression":
        warmup:
          walk 22m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic breathing 2x8 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          sit-to-stand (tempo 3-1-1) 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge to chair 3x10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x10 rpe 4 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper Push + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          wall push-up (moderate incline) 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          wall slides 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 38m "Walk + Step Capacity":
        warmup:
          walk 22m
        main straight_sets:
          step-up to low step (controlled) 3x8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk varied pace 4x30 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Walk + Strength Blend":
        warmup:
          walk 25m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand (tempo 3-1-1) 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge to chair 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          wall push-up (moderate incline) 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Mobility + Control":
        warmup:
          walk 15m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 3x10 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          wall slides 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Walk + Steps and Balance":
        warmup:
          walk 25m
        main straight_sets:
          step-up to low step 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk 4x36 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic floor holds 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3: Weeks 9-12 (Build to Moderate Activity)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Walk + Strength Circuit (Low Impact)":
        warmup:
          walk 25m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand (slow) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge to chair 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          wall push-up (moderate incline) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 38m "Mobility + Control and March":
        warmup:
          walk 18m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 3x12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          wall slides 3x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 42m "Walk + Step Volume":
        warmup:
          walk 25m
        main straight_sets:
          step-up to low step 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk 4x40 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Functional Strength":
        warmup:
          walk 28m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand (tempo 3-1-1) 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge to chair 4x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          wall push-up (lower incline) 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility + Upper Focus":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          wall slides 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing shoulder taps (wall support) 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated marching 3x15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Steps and Balance":
        warmup:
          walk 28m
        main straight_sets:
          step-up to low step 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk varied pace 4x44 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic floor holds 3x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Strength Steady":
        warmup:
          walk 30m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand (slow) 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge to chair 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          wall push-up (lower incline) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x15 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility + Control":
        warmup:
          walk 20m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 3x12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          wall slides 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 3x12..15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching 3x15 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Volume Steps":
        warmup:
          walk 30m
        main straight_sets:
          step-up to low step 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk 4x48 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic floor quick flicks 3x15 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Walk + Functional Capacity":
        warmup:
          walk 30m
        main straight_sets:
          sit-to-stand (tempo 3-1-1) 4x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip hinge to chair 4x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          wall push-up (lower incline) 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing calf raises (single-leg supported) 3x15 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Mobility + Control (Deload Feel)":
        warmup:
          walk 22m
        main straight_sets:
          sidelying open books 2x12 rpe 2 rest 45 seconds
          wall slides 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          scapular retraction holds 2x12 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          seated marching 2x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          seated hamstring stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Walk + Step Confidence":
        warmup:
          walk 30m
        main straight_sets:
          step-up to low step 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing hip abduction 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tandem walk 4x50 steps rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          pelvic floor holds 3x12 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          easy walk 5m
